name: Fin
about: Fin is Zei's best friend from Pafogai Du, who joins the Bansunpei language body. The book does not describe his appearance, so this look is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: Fin and Zei got off the autobus
It was Fin - to Zei's relief, completely uninjured.
facts.fact: Uninjured in the chapter 2 bombing; helps Zei up.

facts.quote: Fin took a small paper booklet out of his backpack.
Looks like the Bansunpei think I'm actually a good fit for them.

descriptor: a young man of about eighteen, stocky and shorter than average, pale freckled skin, a shaggy mop of copper-red hair and a wide friendly face, wearing a cherry-red hooded poncho-shell with a curved hem and glowing yellow seams, a white seamless crew-neck undersuit, tan segmented cargo trousers gathered at the ankles, chunky yellow glowing-soled sneakers and a well-worn rounded modular backpack
sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet on a plain flat off-white background with no scenery: three full-body views of the same person side by side, front view facing the viewer, three-quarter view, and back view, neutral standing pose, even lighting. The person is a young man of about eighteen, stocky and shorter than average, pale freckled skin, a shaggy mop of copper-red hair and a wide friendly face, wearing a cherry-red hooded poncho-shell with a curved hem and glowing yellow seams, a white seamless crew-neck undersuit, tan segmented cargo trousers gathered at the ankles, chunky yellow glowing-soled sneakers and a well-worn rounded modular backpack.
costume_notes: A hooded poncho-shell with glowing seams replaces the windbreaker in the same cherry red, and keeps the backpack the book gives him.
